title: ThinkHazard!: the level of each natural hazard for an administrative unit
format: Asked on demand by data/acquisition/services.py and kept in data/cache/thinkhazard/. JSON: a search of units by name; a unit's report of eleven hazards, each high, medium, low, very low or no data.
coverage: Administrative units of the Global Administrative Unit Layers, level 2 at finest.
licence: Open for use with attribution (the site's terms); the code is GPL-3.0 and is not used.
